s.en: send reboot notifications to NFS peers

o.en: Keeps sm-notify attached to its controlling terminal and running in the foreground so that notification progress may be monitored directly.
Send notifications even if sm-notify has already run since the last system reboot.

Specifies the length of time, in minutes, to continue retrying notifications to unresponsive hosts. If this option is not specified, sm-notify attempts to send notifications for 15 minutes. Specifying a value of 0 causes sm-notify to continue sending notifications to unresponsive peers until it is manually killed.
Prevents sm-notify from updating the local system's NSM state number.

Specifies the source port number sm-notify should use when sending reboot notifications. If this option is not specified, a randomly chosen ephemeral port is used. This option can be used to traverse a firewall between client and server.

Specifies the pathname of the parent directory where NSM state information resides. If this option is not specified, sm-notify uses /var/lib/nfs by default. After starting, sm-notify attempts to set its effective UID and GID to the owner and group of the subdirectory sm of this directory.
Specifies the network address from which to send reboot notifications, and the mon_name argument to use when sending SM_NOTIFY requests.
